posts.author: marclou
posts.text:
- iPhone Duo is a flop 
- MacBook touchscreen is a flop 
- Apple homeview is useless 
- AirPods are the same in years 
- iPhones are the same in years 

I want to give Apple money. A lot of money. They just don’t want it.

Why aren’t they going all in on the Vision Pro? Or a tiny portable device? Or just… AI?

The future of computers isn’t a device with a flat touchscreen and a keyboard.

Steve would agree, I think.
posts.text_zh:
- iPhone Duo 是个失败品
- MacBook 触屏是个失败品
- Apple homeview 没什么用
- AirPods 好几年都没变化
- iPhone 好几年都没变化

我想给苹果送钱，很多很多钱。可他们就是不想要。

他们为什么不全力押注 Vision Pro？或者做一个小巧的便携设备？或者干脆……押注 AI？

电脑的未来不是一块带平面触摸屏和键盘的设备。

我想，Steve 也会同意的。
